provenance.paper_title: RoboOS-NeXT: A Unified Memory-based Framework for Lifelong, Scalable, and Robust Multi-Robot Collaboration

evidence.paraphrase: STEM is updated from mapping, tool-calling feedback, task execution, and robot state changes.; Task/event history is written into temporal memory.; Robot embodiment/capability state is written into embodiment memory.. spatial query over the map conditioned on current observation and instruction.

STEM is updated from mapping, tool-calling feedback, task execution, and robot state changes.; Task/event history is written into temporal memory.; Robot embodiment/capability state is written into embodiment memory.. spatial query over the map conditioned on current observation and instruction.
During operation, RoboOS-NeXT applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Spatial-Embodiment Memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, RoboOS-NeXT applies fixed-rule correction of stored state to Spatial-Embodiment Memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, RoboOS-NeXT applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to Spatial-Embodiment Memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.
During operation, RoboOS-NeXT applies explicit deletion or eviction of stored items to Spatial-Embodiment Memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (Spatial-Embodiment Memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state, relinking or reindexing of stored items, explicit deletion or eviction of stored items; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
